pages.text: Pack magic resistance before you go in. Blue Skies adds two T2 dimensions, the Everbright (light and order) and the Everdawn (dark and chaos), and both fight with elemental damage.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Elemental damage in Blue Skies goes through standard armor, so magic resistance (the Sorcery tree, the Battlemage class) is worth more here than raw armor stats.$(br2)$(bold)Bosses:$() The Summoner, the Alchemist, the Starlit Crusher and the Arachnarch each drop a Simply Swords unique.
$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$() Blue Skies chest loot banks Exploration tokens at a slightly higher rate than Twilight Forest's. The dimensions are dense, and looting them pays accordingly.

$(bold)No guide book.$() You learn Blue Skies by exploring it: the dungeon loot and boss fights in both dimensions lead you on. JEI has every crafting recipe.$(br2)$(bold)Next: find a Gatekeeper's house in the Overworld.$() The Gatekeeper sells the keys to both dimensions' dungeons.
